description: This file contains an implementation of AES encryption aligned with FIPS-197 standards, including key setup, encryption, decryption, and self-test routines, with support for various modes like ECB, CBC, CFB, CTR, and OFB, and conditional hardware acceleration support.

methods.name: mbedtls_zeroize
methods.description: Securely zeroes out memory to prevent sensitive data retention.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with AES context.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_setkey_enc
methods.description: Sets up encryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_setkey_dec
methods.description: Sets up decryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a single 16-byte block using AES.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a single 16-byte block using AES.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_ecb
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in ECB mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_cbc
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CBC mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_cfb128
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CFB128 mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_cfb8
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CFB8 mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_ctr
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CTR mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_ofb
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in OFB mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_self_test
methods.description: Runs self-test vectors to verify AES implementation correctness.
